# Posture bundles (derived defaults)

One line per setting: NAME — default — meaning. Code anchors and full prose:
`docs/CONFIGURATION.md`. Index: `references/configuration.md`.

- POLYROB_OVERRIDES — default: unset — comma list of `MEMBER=true` / `MEMBER=false` entries that changes single posture members (the names in the table below) and nothing else.

### Posture members (generated from `core/config_policy`)

A posture member is set ONLY with `polyrob config set NAME true|false` (a terminal command) or a `POLYROB_OVERRIDES=NAME=true,OTHER=false` line in the env file; a plain `NAME=true` env line is IGNORED. `propose_setting` files the line for the owner.

| Bundle | When | Members it turns ON |
|---|---|---|
| POLYROB_LOCAL | on (the CLI sets it) | AGENT_STATUS_TOOL, AVATAR_TOOL_ENABLED, CODING_TOOLS_ENABLED, CONTEXT_REFERENCES_ENABLED, GIT_TOOLS_ENABLED, INVOICE_CARD_ENABLED, KB_AUTO_PREFETCH, KB_ENABLED, MESSAGE_TOOL_ENABLED, PREFS_TOOL_ENABLED, PROJECT_CONTEXT_AUTOLOAD, TOOL_PROGRESSIVE_DISCLOSURE, VERIFY_BEFORE_DONE |
| POLYROB_LOCAL + AUTONOMY_ENABLED | both on | BACKGROUND_REVIEW_ENABLED, CONTINUITY_BRIDGE_ENABLED, CURATOR_ENABLED, DELIVERABLES_ATTACH_ENABLED, EPISODIC_DIGEST_INJECT, EPISODIC_MEMORY_ENABLED, GOALS_ENABLED, INSIGHTS_TOOL, KNOWLEDGE_CURATOR_ENABLED, OWNER_DOC_WRITABLE, SELF_CONTEXT_WRITABLE, SELF_EVOLUTION_TRANSPARENCY, SELF_WAKE_ENABLED, SKILLS_WRITABLE |
| AUTONOMY_MODE | autonomous | CORRESPONDENT_ACCESS_ENABLED, CORRESPONDENT_REPLY_ENABLED, EMAIL_SURFACE_ENABLED, GROUP_CHAT_ENABLED, MCP_ENABLED, MESSAGE_AUTONOMOUS_ALLOWLISTED, TWITTER_ENABLED, X402_INVOICE_ENABLED, X402_SETTLE_ONCHAIN_DETECT |
| AUTONOMY_POSTURE | owner-visible | AUTONOMOUS_CONTINUITY_BRIDGE, EPISODIC_DIGEST_INJECT, EPISODIC_MEMORY_ENABLED, GOAL_COMPLETION_JUDGE, GOAL_SELF_WAKE_ENABLED, REFLECTION_ON_SESSION_CLOSE |
| AUTONOMY_POSTURE | full | AUTONOMOUS_CONTINUITY_BRIDGE, CRON_ENABLED, EPISODIC_DIGEST_INJECT, EPISODIC_MEMORY_ENABLED, GOAL_COMPLETION_JUDGE, GOAL_SELF_WAKE_ENABLED, REFLECTION_ON_SESSION_CLOSE, WAKE_CHANGE_GATE |
| AGENT_BUILDER_MODE | build or ship | GITHUB_TOOL_ENABLED, PUBLISH_ENABLED |
| AGENT_BUILDER_MODE | ship | APP_SERVICE_ALLOW_PUBLIC, APP_SERVICE_ENABLED |
| AGENT_COMPUTE_POSTURE | 1 or higher | CODE_EXEC_DOCKER_PERSISTENT, SHELL_TOOLS_ENABLED |
| AGENT_COMPUTE_POSTURE | 2 or higher | SELF_ENV_ENABLED |
